then.text: Enjoy your voyage. Don't feed the patty to the gulls, they'll follow you to Iceland.

else.text: For the Corsair? On the house, duck. One patty, wrapped, still hot.

hul_frier.text: Patty, chips and a scraps on top. That's Hull. Mashed spud and sage, battered, fried golden. Want a few for the road?
